prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and lighting-weather edit. Create an improved version of the existing Tomasz Kaszubowski portrait for the same basketball roster photo series as Damian.
Image roles: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, Tomasz #12 in the accepted black-red jersey A. Image 2 is Damian #24, REFERENCE ONLY for photography: lighting, white balance, camera position, perspective, head-to-body scale, framing. Image 3 is the original real Tomasz photo, IDENTITY reference only for his own face, hair, beard, age and anatomy. Never blend Damian's facial features or body into Tomasz.
Requested changes: match image 2's neutral balanced photographic color grading and soft studio frontal light, realistic moderate contrast, dark black textile without crushing detail, rich red fabric with the same saturation as Damian. Remove the excess orange/yellow cast and harsh plastic microcontrast in image 1. Skin should look naturally photographic like the original real Tomasz in image 3, no smoothing or beauty retouch.
Match image 2's camera geometry: straight-on camera at eye level, portrait-lens perspective with no selfie/wide-angle distortion or downward viewing angle, near level shoulders, upright head, body centered and facing camera. Preserve Tomasz's recognizable face, original small smile, hair and goatee, normal slender build and his bare arms; do not add Damian's black undershirt or sleeves. Do not copy Damian's stern expression.
Framing: vertical 4:5 portrait, centered, head completely visible with a small 4 percent margin above hair, show torso down to hips as in Damian, entire shoulders visible, natural similar face-to-torso proportion, comfortably fill the width as in image 2. Avoid the previous square frame's excess blank top/side margins. Keep the black-red sleeveless jersey A from image 1, solid red number "12", PROTON, yellow BeKaPaKa BOBOLICE emblem, BAUMAL and Fem-Tech arrangement; continue its same existing lower red angular pattern naturally to the bottom crop. Do not substitute number 24, redesign shirt or invent extra labels.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, clean natural hair and silhouette edges, no red/yellow halo, no scenery, no backdrop, no outline, no watermark. Only Tomasz in his existing uniform. This is a photographic local visualization, keep identity clearly that of Tomasz.
description: Na bezpośrednie zlecenie użytkownika dopasowano światło, kolory, kąt kamery, perspektywę i kadrowanie do portretu Damiana. Front i szerszy kadr tułowia rekonstruowane przez AI; nie jest dokumentalnym zdjęciem ani retuszem zachowującym piksele osoby. Numer 12, czarno-czerwony strój A, przezroczyste tło. Oryginał i v1/v2 zachowane; wyłącznie lokalny podgląd bez CMS/API/deployu.
